title: Session Management System (DESKTOP-794)
outcome: Implement SessionManager service with multi-window conflict detection, inactivity timeout (15min), auto-token refresh, connection pool management (4 max), environment flags for opt-in deployment.
rationale: Enterprise security requires inactivity timeout and multi-window detection. BroadcastChannel enables performant conflict detection. Connection pool prevents browser stalls. Feature flags enable gradual rollout.

risk.acceptance: Complex implementation (2244 lines) but necessary for enterprise security. BroadcastChannel not in IE11 but acceptable (modern browsers only). Gradual rollout via feature flags mitigates deployment risk.

technical_debt.resolution: Accept as technical debt, convert during Vue 3 migration

technical_debt.issue: Connection pool max is conservative (4 vs 6-10 browser limit)
technical_debt.resolution: Monitor and increase after production testing

deployment_strategy: Phase 4: Enable for all users after 2 weeks testing
Rollback: Set feature flag to false if issues
